name: Enterprise Internal Policy
constraints: Every effective policy resolves adopting authority, mandate, adoption decision and in-force instant.
Local tailoring may tighten only under an explicit precedence edge.
Exceptions are bounded derogations with separate authority, scope, interval and compensation semantics.
Non-derogable superior rules cannot be weakened by inheritance or exception.
Unknown applicability and unresolved conflicts produce an explicit unresolved result.
Acknowledgement is external communication evidence and does not affect policy resolution.
